test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following forms the lining of kidney tubules and duets of salivary glands?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Cuboidal epithelium__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• **Cuboidal epithelium** forms the lining of kidney tubules and duets of salivary glands.
 
• It **provides** **mechanical support** to the tubules and the glands.
